questions.subject: Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: Explain the difference between search algorithms and knowledge representation in Artificial Intelligence.
questions.ideal_answer: search algorithms and knowledge representation differ in several ways: search algorithms is problem-solving through search (works by uninformed and informed search) whereas knowledge representation is formalizing information for AI (works by semantic networks, frames, rules, ontologies). search algorithms is typically used for BFS, DFS, UCS, A*, IDA*, minimax, alpha-beta, while knowledge representation is used for RDF, OWL, description logics. Example demonstrating search algorithms: A* with admissible heuristic. Example demonstrating knowledge representation: expert systems, knowledge graphs.
